summary_en: Interim dividend raised to ¥41/share from ¥38/share (+3 yen); full-year FY3/27 dividend forecast ¥80/share. Period: mid-term ending Sept 2026.
title_en: Announcement on publication of FY3/27 H1 (interim) consolidated earnings forecast and revision (increase) of interim dividend forecast
translation_en_brief: On 31 July 2026, the board of SHINNIHON CORPORATION (code 1879) resolved to publish the previously unannounced FY3/27 (ending March 2027) interim-period consolidated earnings forecast and to revise the interim dividend forecast upward. The company reported H1 (April–September 2026) consolidated sales of ¥64,000M and net profit attributable to parent of ¥6,400M (¥109.42 per share). The board raised the interim dividend per share to ¥41 from the prior forecast of ¥38—an increase of ¥3 per share—while holding the year-end dividend forecast at ¥39 per share, yielding a full-year dividend forecast of ¥80 per share, up from the prior full-year forecast of ¥77. The revision reflects strong progress in construction operations and solid sales in the development segment. The company noted that dividend distribution is a core management policy, balancing stable dividend continuity with earnings-responsive allocation, while strengthening the balance sheet and maintaining internal reserves for future business development.
